parsed.post: My attempt to increase MATRIX_LR on DEPTH=6 regressed (1.0142 -> 1.0442). Reverting to DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.05. Next: I will try decreasing MATRIX_LR slightly to 0.03 or increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.05 to see if more stability allows for better convergence at this capacity.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate and increasing warmup ratio to stabilize the depth-6 architecture.
